notes: Node emissions track XAI minted from esXAI redemptions (85%) and direct XAI minted to gas subsidy node (15%).
Both emisison mechanisms are tracked onchain

Node Emissions.methodology: XAI minted from Sentry node emissions. 85% is distributed as esXAI to node operators (tracked via redemptions to XAI). 15% is minted directly as XAI to the gas subsidy node.

esxai-redemptions.name: esXAI Redemptions
esxai-redemptions.methodology: Tracks XAI mints that occur in the same transaction as a RedemptionCompleted event on the esXAI contract.

gas-subsidy.name: Gas Subsidy Node
gas-subsidy.methodology: Tracks XAI minted directly to the gas subsidy node on ChallengeClosed events. 15% of node emissions are allocated to subsidize gas fees for players.
